## Tools this post exists to feed

- [`social-image-resizer`](/tools/social-image-resizer) - Social Image Resizer: One image, cropped to every size the networks actually use.
- [`engagement-rate-calculator`](/tools/engagement-rate-calculator) - Engagement Rate Calculator: Work out your engagement rate — and whether it is actually any good.
- [`username-availability-checker`](/tools/username-availability-checker) - Username Availability Checker: One handle, checked against every network’s rules at once.
- [`link-preview-debugger`](/tools/link-preview-debugger) - Link Preview Debugger: What X, Facebook and LinkedIn will show when you share your link.
- [`hashtag-generator`](/tools/hashtag-generator) - Hashtag Generator: Balanced hashtag sets — mostly niche, where a small account can actually rank.

At least one `[[tool:slug]]` card goes in the body at the moment the reader needs
it - not parked at the end. Link `/tools/<slug>` in prose as well, with the tool's
own name as the anchor.

## Non-negotiables

- Every platform limit, threshold or payout figure carries the date it was checked
  and a link to the platform's own documentation. Numbers age; undated numbers rot.
- No invented search volumes, no invented benchmarks. If we did not measure it, we
